capabilities.name: Create source file
capabilities.description: Create a source-code file inside project code storage.

capabilities.name: Open source file
capabilities.description: Open an existing code file for editing.

capabilities.name: Edit and save source file
capabilities.description: Edit code text and persist changes to disk.
capabilities.notes: Saved content persists across close and reopen.

capabilities.name: Nested folder workspace
capabilities.description: Browse, create, rename, move, and delete files and nested directories.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Workspace and File Explorer
capabilities.notes: Nested folders and rename/delete are explicitly missing from Code IDE v0.

capabilities.name: Multi-file tabbed editor
capabilities.description: Edit multiple project files using a polished tabbed editor.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Dev v2 Official v1 Target
capabilities.notes: Basic editor exists; official-v1 multi-file workflow still needs build-out and validation.

capabilities.name: Syntax highlighting
capabilities.description: Provide strong language-aware syntax highlighting.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Dev v2 Official v1 Target
capabilities.notes: Code IDE v0 only detects a basic language label from extension.

capabilities.name: Line numbers and editor navigation
capabilities.description: Provide line numbering, scrolling, cursor navigation, and standard editor navigation behavior.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Beta and Official v1 Editor
capabilities.notes: Requires current implementation audit before complete status.

capabilities.name: Find and replace
capabilities.description: Search and replace content within files and across the workspace.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Search and Replace

capabilities.name: Split editors and customizable layout
capabilities.description: Support split editor groups and user-customizable IDE layout.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / v1.x and Official v1 Targets

capabilities.name: Command palette and shortcuts
capabilities.description: Expose IDE commands through a searchable palette and customizable shortcuts.

capabilities.name: Language detection
capabilities.description: Identify file language from project and file metadata.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Basic Language Modes
capabilities.notes: Current implementation performs basic extension-based language detection.

capabilities.name: Language server support
capabilities.description: Provide Language Server Protocol integration for supported languages.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Completion and Language-Server Support

capabilities.name: Code completion
capabilities.description: Provide language-aware code completion and suggestions.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Completion and Language-Server Support

capabilities.name: Symbol navigation
capabilities.description: Navigate to definitions, references, symbols, and related code locations.

capabilities.name: Formatting and lint integration
capabilities.description: Run language-aware formatting and linting tools and display diagnostics.

capabilities.name: Integrated terminal
capabilities.description: Provide an interactive terminal inside the Code IDE.
capabilities.notes: Terminal integration is explicitly absent from Code IDE v0.

capabilities.name: Build and project tasks
capabilities.description: Define, execute, monitor, cancel, and reuse project build and automation tasks.

capabilities.name: Run workflow
capabilities.description: Launch and monitor project programs and commands from the IDE.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Run Debug Workflows
capabilities.notes: Run flow is explicitly absent from Code IDE v0.

capabilities.name: Basic debugging
capabilities.description: Provide basic launch, breakpoint, stepping, and runtime inspection workflows for supported runtimes.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Run Debug Workflows
capabilities.notes: Debugging is explicitly absent from Code IDE v0.

capabilities.name: Git integration
capabilities.description: Provide common source-control status, staging, commit, branch, and diff workflows.

capabilities.name: Testing support
capabilities.description: Discover, execute, and report supported project tests.

capabilities.name: IDE extension support
capabilities.description: Extend Code IDE functionality through the PL extension system.
capabilities.notes: Suite-level plugin infrastructure exists, but the official-v1 Code IDE extension API is not complete.

capabilities.name: Workspace trust
capabilities.description: Restrict potentially dangerous project, extension, terminal, and task behavior until the user trusts a workspace.

capabilities.name: Integrated code documentation
capabilities.description: Provide inline documentation, Markdown preview, linked docs, and code-to-Docs workflows.

capabilities.name: Cross-slice development workflows
capabilities.description: Connect source code to Docs, Spreadsheets, Modeling, Animation, and Game Studio workflows.
capabilities.notes: Includes shaders, scripts, data files, generated docs, project metrics, game scripts, and asset tooling.

capabilities.name: Project-aware AI coding assistance
capabilities.description: Provide permissioned code explanation, generation, refactoring, diagnostics, and proposed patch workflows.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / AI Copilot Capabilities
capabilities.notes: AI file edits should use reviewable patches and must not silently rewrite user files.

capabilities.name: Autosave and recovery
capabilities.description: Recover unsaved source changes and editor state after interruption.
capabilities.source: PL Code IDE / Autosave and Recovery
